people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Therefore when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”
translations.bsb: So when they came together, they asked Him, “Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?”
translations.kjv: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
translations.asv: They therefore, when they were come together, asked him, saying, Lord, dost thou at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?
